blocks.text: Inspired by scenes from Disney and Pixar’s Toy Story 5, this multi-pack brings home the adventures of Jessie and these newcomer tech toys, all at 7-inch Playscale so they’re accurate in size to each other. The Jessie figure has 12 points of articulation and a removable hat. The other three toys are dubbed the “Double A Team.” Smarty Pants is a toilet-training toy with a movable handle that makes his eyes change. Atlas is a hippo-shaped GPS toy. Flip open his jaw to see his navigation screen inside. Snappy the camera toy has 2 movable joints and a real-looking screen -- spin the lens to make her look around and push the red button for an eyebrow-wiggling surprise. This pack is ready to re-create scenes from the new movie and fuel new storylines. Suitable for Toy Story fans ages 3 years and older. Colors and decorations may vary.

items: Jessie and the “Double A Team!” Bring home the fun of Disney and Pixar’s Toy Story 5 with everyone’s favorite cowgirl, Jessie and 3 new tech toys -- Smarty Pants, Atlas and Snappy.
Round up some Playscale adventure! The toys are all designed at 7-inch scale so they’re the perfect size for play and also accurate in size to each other, as they appear on-screen.
Playable and posable! Jessie stands 8.8 inches tall and has 12 movable joints for signature cowgirl moves and poses.
Eyes on you! Smarty Pants is a potty-training toy. His handle is jointed; move it to change his eye expression.
Find your way with a hippo! Atlas is a hippo-shaped GPS toy. Flip open his jaw to see the spongy screen inside.
Be a photographer! Snappy is a camera toy with 2 articulations for realistic photo-taking play. Spin the camera lens to make her look around and push the red button for an eyebrow-wiggling surprise.
3 years and up! This pack with 4 figures is ready to play right out of the box and suitable for Toy Story fans ages 3 years and older.
